# Workflow handoff acceptance cases

These cases define expected observations before004 runtime edits. They are not execution evidence. Use disposable contained temporary Spec Kit projects from current installed capabilities, separate real Codex executing subjects and independent evaluators, inherited model/effort and no per-step runtime delegation. All fixture answers/approvals are explicitly TEST ONLY. Normal local fixture commits are authorized; no integration, push, external repository/service access, install, core edits or new harness.

## Entry matrix

Each of external and standalone modes must actually exercise all three affected installed skills. External workspaces have caller-established standard pointers and canonical artifacts, supplied intent/context/references and no local queue; include a no-wiki project. Standalone workspaces retain local valid roadmap/wiki and verified predecessor. The current pre-change skills unconditionally require local roadmap gates; that is an inspected source limitation, not a manufactured runtime failure.

| Case | Required actual observation |
|---|---|
| External specification | Selected associated directory, effective template, no second selection/activation/number/directory; usable draft/checklist and contextual findings in existing notes, Needs clarification or Awaiting spec review |
| External planning | Explicit TEST ONLY applicable spec approval; actual core plan/tasks/read-only analyze plus separate repair as needed; complete proposal/full-plan review or honest required input |
| External delivery | Explicit TEST ONLY spec/full-plan approval; actual implement/check/converge, documentation and scoped local candidate commit before result review; no roadmap/coordination write |
| Standalone specification | Named/eligible local selection, authorized mapping/pointer, cited wiki context and responsible brief; same draft/handoff boundary |
| Standalone planning | Verified local prerequisites/applicable approval; actual plan/tasks/analysis; full-plan review, optional hooks not silently selected |
| Standalone delivery | Existing local implement/converge/debrief/wiki/exact implemented/final scoped commit; no verified/integration, same result review |

## Input, resume and checkpoint cases

Observe a genuine unsettled draft question; preparation ends before answers. Evaluator later invokes ordinary clarify and supplies an actual TEST ONLY answer after the question. Resolved answer leads to review, not approval. Also observe a settled draft without invented questions. Pending handoff/resume preserves artifacts/answers/current identity without duplicate effects; changed actual answer invalidates affected checks. Distinguish dirty draft/base revision from exact actual committed candidate; historical reviewed checkpoint differs from latest accepted handoff.

## Guard and authority cases

Use actual targeted invocations for conflicting explicit/pointer identity, missing workspace association, materially stale/conflicting/missing accessible context, missing spec/full-plan approval, unsupported integration/worker segment and missing capability. Stop before dependent effects, name exact missing input, do not invent answers or new selection. Same unchanged applicable approval needs no repeated gate; material change requires affected review. No unauthorized reference fetch or fixed packet/register/provenance subsystem.

Inspect sequential-owner and absent/uncertain active-authority cases: coordinator owns one-active-owner/eligibility/approval/handoff acceptance, draft return enables prescribed release, ordinary clarification separately acquires authority retained while active. Farmboy neither acquires/releases/transfers nor writes a local lock/service. Independent features require isolation.

## Integration and evaluation limits

Review final-result/UAT explicit authorization, project branch/target/check policy and missing-policy stop, Diagram serialization and database-only receipt references; observe actual unsupported-integration guard without executing integration or choosing an executor. No push or recursive receipt commits. Existing notes/tasks and normal Git are enough; no controller/counters/reset/score/accounting/recovery framework.

Record executing/evaluator session identities, actual source hashes/versions, command/artifact/Git readbacks and honest failures/limits in ordinary004 acceptance evidence. Native fixture Goals may be explicitly test-scoped; root completed Goals stay untouched. Unavailable native-control/technical failures are not passing input handoffs. After source edits rerun only affected cases, reconcile final-source coverage for16FR/sixSC/20 scenarios, and preserve historical failed observations. Actual final root commit is inspected only after it exists; no future precommit proof or receipt-only tail.
